reuse.why: Fintegra links through the existing guardBankAccountLink and new shared linkBankSyncAccount/linkOrgBankSyncAccount and downloadOrgBankSyncTransactions that also serve the existing providers.

duplication.why: Collapses the copied provider link bodies and the Pluggy/Akahu download copies, and joins Fintegra to Akahu's starting-balance branch instead of copying it.

placement.why: Link logic stays in accounts/app.ts and downloads in sync.ts as in the tree; the curried linkOrgBankSyncAccount factory is a slightly unusual shape for handler definitions.

scope.why: Rewrites every existing provider's link and download path, which goes beyond adding Fintegra, and in passing generalises provider-specific details (the Pluggy-only file id is now passed for every provider, mask inserted as null for all).

maintainability.why: One link path and one download path make future providers cheap, but the silently generalised file id/mask hide what used to be explicit per-provider differences.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra registration goes through guardBankAccountLink and the shared link/download helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: Former copies were merged into shared functions.
